result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): A keeps all its text in the darker purple part of the sky. Its string lights and skyline silhouette make it feel festive, and the yellow button stands out clearly against the magenta behind it. B shows the dates twice, and its tagline sits on a lighter pink-coral band. B's orange button blends into the orange horizon below it, and the bottom fade to dark makes a muddy brownish band. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): B keeps all of its text in the darker purple part of the sky. Its glowing string of lanterns and its building skyline make the page read as a festive night scene, and the amber button stands out clearly against the magenta. A is clean and legible too, but it shows the dates twice, its button sits on a coral area where the contrast is weaker, and there is a muddy brownish band where the sky fades into the dark strip at the bottom. B's 'Night Market' label above the title is redundant, and the button crowds the lantern line a little, but overall B is stronger.
